➢ Professional Summary – 
Digital Transformation Consultant with 9+ years of experience in Process Excellence, Business Excellence, Lean Six Sigma, Business Process 
Reengineering, Automation, and Data Analytics. Proven expertise in partnering with business stakeholders to analyze, standardize, and 
optimize business processes, identify automation opportunities, redesign workflows, and deliver scalable, data -driven solutions that 
enhance operational efficiency, governance, and business performance.  Strong background in Quality Management Systems (QMS), 
enterprise Business Excellence frameworks, and process governance, including organization-wide deployment and maturity assessments 
of business excellence frameworks.

WNS Global Services - Digital Transformation Manager                                                                     May 2026 onwards                                                                                            
• Drive digital transformation initiatives  by partnering with client stakeholders and operations teams to analyze, redesign, standardize, 
and optimize end-to-end business processes aligned with operational and business objectives. 
• Drive Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement initiatives  using DMAIC, process mapping, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and data -
driven methodologies to identify process gaps, eliminate inefficiencies, and improve business performance. 
• Gather and translate business requirements into current-state and future-state (AS-IS / TO-BE,) process designs, workflow requirements, 
and solution specifications, collaborating with cross-functional teams through implementation and adoption.  
• Analyze process performance and operational metrics , developing KPIs, dashboards, and data -driven insights to identify bottlenecks, 
monitor improvement opportunities, and support informed decision-making.  
• Collaborate with global client stakeholders and cross -functional teams  to facilitate process workshops, validate proposed solutions, 
manage dependencies, and support sustainable adoption of transformation initiatives. 
 
Bristlecone India Limited (Mahindra Group) – Lead Business Excellence                                       Nov 2021 – Apr 2026 
• Drove enterprise-wide Business Process Re -engineering (BPR), Digital Transformation and Continuous Improvement initiatives across 
enabling functions including Procurement, HR, Finance , Workplace Solutions and Delivery Operations, driving end -to-end workflow 
transformation, standardization, operational efficiency, and process maturity enhancement. 
• Supported the enterprise-wide adoption and maturity improvement of Mahindra Group's Business Excellence framework, The Mahindra 
Way (TMW), aligned with Total Quality Management (TQM) principles. Worked across management and business processes to support 
Business Excellence deployment, process standardization, strategy deployment, governance, organizational maturity, and continuous 
improvement. 
• Led internal audits across business processes and functions  to assess compliance with the Mahindra Group’s Business Excellence 
framework (TMW), and translat ing audit  findings into  Six Sigma driven process improvements , focused on  defect reduction, waste 
elimination, cycle-time optimization, and risk mitigation through FMEA and CAPA. 
• Coordinated the annual Business Excellence (TMW) assessment  conducted by the Mahindra Institute of Quality  (MIQ), acting as the 
central point of coordination between MIQ and cross -functional process owners. Managed assessment planning, stakeholder 
coordination, documentation, evidence readiness, and follow-up on observations and improvement actions (CAPA). 
• Collaborated across stakeholders to represent continuous improvement initiatives and worked with Senior Directors, VPs, and 
SVPs on annual Business Excellence assessment presentations. 
• Served as the organizational point of contact for Group Common Policies & Practices (GCPP) assessments across Risk Management,  
Sustainability, CSR, and Safety, supporting governance, alignment, assessment readiness, compliance, and continuous improvement. 
• Owned and led the enterprise-wide Kaizen Program,  driving a structured continuous improvement  culture through Kaizen, Lean 
principles, process mapping, and Six Sigma DMAIC  methodology. Governed the complete Kaizen lifecycle  from idea registration, 
evaluation, implementation, validation, horizontal deployment, and recognition, ensuring sustainable business impact across functions. 
• Served as the Kaizen Subject Matter Expert (SME), coaching teams on problem identification, root cause analysis, solution development, 
and implementation best practices. Conducted organization -wide Kaizen awareness and capability -building sessions  to improve 
participation and execution quality. 
• Developed standardized Kaizen evaluation criteria, review mechanisms, and governance practices to improve consistency, transparency, 
and effectiveness of Kaizen implementation across the organization. 
• Designed and deployed automated Power BI dashboards  to monitor enterprise -wide Kaizen performance, implementation status, 
approvals, benefit realization, horizontal deployment, and recognition metrics, enabling leadership governance, transparency,  and data-
driven decision-making. 
• Partnered with  process owners to identify transformation opportunities , redesign operating models, streamline workflows, and 
implement continuous improvement initiatives aligned with organizational strategic objectives and enterprise governance frameworks. 
• Leveraged Python and SQL to develop automation solutions, optimize data processing and reporting workflows, and support Lean Six 
Sigma and digital transformation initiatives through data-driven insights and process automation. 
• Conducted end -to-end process assessments, process mapping, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, and CAPA  exercises to identify 
operational gaps, redesign workflows, mitigate risks, and implement scalable process improvement solutions across business fu nctions. 
• Skilled in process mapping and process modelling using BPMN and Visio, supporting AS -IS / TO -BE analysis, workflow redesign, 
and business process improvement. 
• Designed and institutionalized a Daily Work Management & Standardization (DWMS)  maturity assessment framework  for delivery 
projects, enabling standardized governance, operational discipline, process adherence, and delivery consistency across projec t teams. 
Developed Power BI dashboards for leadership reviews, providing visibility into maturity trends, compliance tracking, KPI performance, 
and continuous improvement opportunities. 
• Certified Six Sigma Black Belt (SSBB)  – expertise in Lean Six Sigma  methodology, advanced statistical tools (Minitab), and process 
transformation. 
• Implemented small -scale process automations using Python , VBA, Power Automate , Power Apps  to streamline manual workflows, 
improve reporting efficiency, reduce turnaround time,  streamlining manual reporting workflows and supporting RPA -led digital 
transformation initiatives. 
• Applied analytics and automation capabilities using Python, SQL, Power BI, and Minitab to build automated reporting solutions, analyze 
trends, improve process visibility, and support data-driven business transformation initiatives. 
• Designed and institutionalized an FMEA framework with standardized SOPs, enabling proactive risk identification and preventive controls 
across the organization. 
• Acted as transformation catalyst  by training associates in Quality, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis, Agile, and Lean practices, embedding a 
culture of continuous improvement across the organization. 
• Trained 1000+ employees every fiscal year on Lean, Kaizen, 7 QC Tools, and Six Sigma methodology; helped identify Six Sigma 
project opportunities and mentored Yellow Belt, Green Belt, and Black Belt projects. 
• Developed training content for Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, and 7 QC Tools to support organization -wide capability building and 
continuous improvement adoption. 
• Owned the continuous improvement lifecycle from project identification and scoping through mentoring and closure, including 4+ 
Black Belt projects at Bristlecone, 2 Yellow Belt projects at WNS, 2+ Green Belt projects at Amazon, and 5+ Yellow Belt and 3 + 
Green Belt projects across other organisations. 
• Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) – trained in Agile philosophy and Scrum framework, with working knowledge of SDLC and program/project 
management practices.

compliance accuracy, and seller trust.
